title: Three Burnt Bridges To A STRANGER 🌉
premise: In our seaside town every friendship builds a little plank bridge between two windows, and burning one makes both friends forget the other ever lived. Three burnt bridges lie in the alley under my window, all running to the window of a man I have never met, and when the nights get cold they start to rise toward us.
twist: The stranger is Eli, my best friend. Every year the night before his boat ships out we stand in the middle of our bridge and burn it together so neither of us has to miss the other, and every spring we meet for the first time. This year we keep the bridge, it grows past his window out over the sea, and I tell him how it started.
world: a bright cobbled alley between tall terracotta and ochre houses with teal shutters, dozens of plank bridges strung between facing windows, and the sea glittering at the end of the lane
